node_definition.done_when: A test in tests/test_a_pick_names_its_slow_stage.py stubs one pick stage to sleep past the dispatch picker deadline. It finds the fallback reason naming that stage (for example "timeout in budget-snapshot"), with the finished stages' elapsed milliseconds recorded on the fallback. A normal pick carries the elapsed milliseconds of all five stages (records, verdict inputs, budget snapshot, context estimate, Jev) on its selection, and reckon/crew/picker/outcomes.py classifies a staged timeout by its stage. The negative control is the base revision, where the reason is the bare "timeout": the new test is run at the base and fails there. The test files that import reckon/crew/dispatch_picker.py or reckon/crew/picker/outcomes.py show no added failure against the base revision. Both arms run in place on the fleet allocation with pytest -n 8 and are logged under the run directory.
